name: Scrapper
body:
Drawbacks
Scrapper
Source Ultimate Campaign pg. 62
Category Race
Requirement(s) Half-Orc
A childhood spent scrabbling for every possession and scrap of food has made you fierce and wary. You receive a +1 trait bonus on all Intimidate checks made to demoralize opponents and a +1 trait bonus on all Perception checks to avoid being surprised.
